purpose: first learned low-dimensional role-preserving GC-BREAK challenger after WP3 closure
conceptual_model: discrete-time transition hazard on governed-origin intervals; not fixed-horizon XAU direction forecasting

literature_basis.reference: Singer and Willett (1993), It's About Time: Using Discrete-Time Survival Analysis to Study Duration and the Timing of Events
Survival prediction models: an introduction to discrete-time modeling (2022)
literature_basis.use: discrete-time binary hazard prediction and Brier/discrimination evaluation

risk_interval.unit: governed origin t -> next governed origin t+1
risk_interval.target: WP2 primary k=3.0 break occurs at t+1
risk_interval.note: Sparse canonical NY17 dates remain sparse; the hazard is per governed-origin interval, not per one-calendar-day horizon.

causal_origin_rule.features: known by completed origin t only
causal_origin_rule.sojourn_age: governed origins since the most recent observed WP2 break; reset to zero on a break origin
causal_origin_rule.left_censor_guard: risk-set/model rows begin only after the first observed formation break so sojourn age is known
causal_origin_rule.outcome_availability: for prediction at t, training outcomes may use intervals ending no later than t

models.role: sensitivity only because price-path anatomy shares the event-label construction

excluded_from_primary_phase_a.EMERGENCY_REVERSAL: WP3 same-origin review found no incremental early-warning recall/detection gain over FAST and a higher false-warning burden; retain as confirmation/context only
excluded_from_primary_phase_a.BOCPD_RETURN_SUCCESSOR_V1: slow native-month regime context; not a daily break trigger
excluded_from_primary_phase_a.MONTHLY_H1: independent strategic price-level forecast, not short-term trigger
excluded_from_primary_phase_a.GVZ_MACRO_MARKET_SHOCK_EXPERT_CHANNELS: optional/partial blocks deferred to later same-origin ablation after WP4 primary

phase_a_decision_rule.positive_signal: M2 improves both Brier score and log loss versus M0 on the common prequential evaluation origins; ranking metrics are descriptive because event count is small
phase_a_decision_rule.fallback_signal: M1 may remain a simpler challenger if M2 does not improve on M1; no model is promoted from sensitivity M3 alone
phase_a_decision_rule.negative_signal: if neither M1 nor M2 improves probability scoring versus M0, stop learned-hazard escalation and return REJECT_LEARNED_HAZARD
phase_a_decision_rule.phase_b_gate: state mapping/WEAKENING/BREAK_ALERT thresholds may be preregistered only after Phase A evidence is inspected
